summary: Gate C: PASS. Wave C (7 fix packages plus this gate) is finished and verified on the final tree. VERIFY (docs/verify_last.txt, one run 20:31-20:55, agent gateC, every step including perfslope and -Android): dotnet 316/318 (2 skipped by design), setup (ShaderCheck 12 shaders, 0 failure), EditMode 493 run / 0 failures / 2 skipped, PlayMode 8/8, buildwindows 93.8 MB, probe liquid -fps 30 and -fps 144 both PASS with the equal hash 246577239DE179C4 (the sim is bit-identical), probe-fire and probe-electric PASS with the same hash, perfslope PASS (18 runs, none shared the machine), android PASS (Build/Android/PainterIO.apk 32.5 MB, VIBRATE in the manifest). OVERALL PASS. TESTS: 815 passing (dotnet 316 + EditMode 491 + PlayMode 8), 0 failing; wave C added 72 EditMode tests (70 by the packages, 2 by the gate; Gate B had 421 EditMode tests). WHAT WAS FIXED (31 plan items: 29 fixed, 2 partial): tutorial lesson for crossing your own thread, tutorial timers that only count visible time, screen sleep and 30 fps while paused (game-flow); UI that fits every aspect (CanvasScaler Expand, checked at 9:16, 20:9 1080x2400, 21:9 1080x2520, tablet 3:4 and landscape 1280x720), readable toasts that avoid the open leaderboard, a visible rival chevron, a calmer menu (scrim, opaque cards, zoomed-out attract, no pop when the attract restarts), a darker results screen without empty bands, cheaper menu previews (ui); a 0.5 u spark glint with a steady flicker and halo, a constant-size home chevron (actors); fire: cheaper composite, real flame tongues in world units, a moving fill band, a white spark brighter than the fireball, Low tier cells instead of a lattice (biome-fire); electric: brighter current packet, colored dead-cable dots, a discharge that rides the fill front, cheaper composite; liquid: clean crease between puddles (biome-electric-liquid); no freeze on the first biome tap (clip sets built in the background), 8 clips that now survive a phone speaker, the territory-loss haptic (audio); render height cap per tier, hitch-proof FPS watchdog, shader clock per session, Android frame pacing and blit settings, no CPU use when minimized, the perfslope measurement step (infra-perf). PERF (ms per Mpix, Medium tier, uncapped, Iris Xe, quiet machine; before = Gate B build measured the same day, plan baseline in brackets; after = final build, best of 3 rounds): liquid 2.24 [2.11] -> 2.14; fire 4.77 [4.34] -> 2.66 (-44 %); electric 3.14 [2.91] -> 2.36 (-25 %). Fire/liquid 2.13 -> 1.25, electric/liquid 1.40 -> 1.10. At 1080x1200 the frame cost is liquid 3.49 -> 3.22 ms, fire 6.40 -> 3.90 ms, electric 4.37 -> 3.44 ms. Fire and electric meet their targets (2.95 and 2.47); liquid misses its 1.86 target (perf-06 partial: branches are correct but give no measurable gain). READABILITY re-measured by the gate (human color pinned to index 0, DevShot Medium 540x960 CutDroplets, luma >= 235 near the spark vs near the human pearl): liquid 1.59x, fire 39x, electric 2.14x (Gate B: 0.09x, 1.13x, about 0.9x); electric packet vs largest pearl 2.74x, 0 bright pixels on the home chevron. REGRESSION REVIEW: gallery docs/waveC/shots/final (three biomes, High and Medium, 540x960 and 1080x2400, plus 21:9, tablet and landscape UI), compared with docs/waveB/shots/gate in docs/waveC/shots/final/compare: liquid V1-V8 and fire / electric 25.3-25.5 still hold, nothing regressed; only the intended changes differ (flame band, spark glint, chevron, menu scrim and zoom, results dim and stacking). GATE FIXES: Hud now reads the tutorial bubble through TutorialOverlay.BubbleRect / BubbleAlpha (no lookup by child name); the menu title is centered in the band on screens taller than 9:16 (9:16 unchanged, pixel check); the fire compile test now compiles every forward pass for Direct3D 11 AND GLES3 (it only compiled GLES3); comments document that the Shader Graph forward pass is target 2.0, so the Gather paths are compiled out and the bilinear fallback is what ships. CONTRACT: docs/CONTRACT.md is v1.6 with section 26 'Wave C as-built amendments' (every wave C contract_issues entry plus the accepted wave B readings). RELEASE BUILDS: Build/Windows/PainterIO.exe (tools/run.cmd) and Build/Android/PainterIO.apk (32.5 MB). WHAT REMAINS: the device playtest of brief 7.7 (touch, haptics including the new territory-loss pulse, 60 fps pacing with Swappy, blit type, screen sleep and 30 fps in pause, render scale on a tall phone, the fire fill on GLES3), listening to the sounds by ear (8 reworked clips, the new electric hum), the user's decisions feel-01 (longer slow motion on near-head cuts and a 'cut right behind you' results line) and feel-11 (final standings list on the results screen), the electric fill junction residual (accepted, contract 26.8) and the liquid per-pixel cost (deferred).
